svg.title: Map Your App: map your app once as a user interface, pathfinding and Localize, a KPI on every move, one variant per model
svg.text: Map your app once. Every test reuses the same screens and keys.
Your app: screens and the moves between them
Each move: a screen, a key, the next screen
You map it once. Every test reuses it.
Write goto, we find the way
Pathfinding takes the shortest path on the map
Localize names the live screen by its fingerprint: the path starts there.
Measured in the background: the test never waits
From the key press to the new screen
From the channel key to the new picture
A plain goto already gives these numbers, with no extra test.
Add only what differs; the same test runs on all
No copy of the map: a variant keeps only what changes, like one key.
A variant can be a model, a firmware, a language or an app build.
